nom: TONYMOLY I'm Rice Clarifying Blemish Mask

avis.texte: I love this product, I use it for my sensitive, oily skin. It works wonderfully and clears my pores of any dirt or grime. I've noticed a significant difference in my comedones since I've been using this product. Helps keep my hormonal acne at bay.
I will forever repurchase this, i have acne prone skin and this clears my acne and smoothes out my texture!

Normally im super cautious with facemasks as I'm prone to breakouts, but this ones great! My skin looked brighter and more even and also helped with some scarring. 10/10 recommend especially for the price

I normally read reviews before buying skincare products but this I bought one day as I needed a pick-me-up and went to Ulta. I used it that need and it made my skin look so good!!! it brightens my skintone and has helped me with my acne. it has not cleared it but it definitely does a lot in 10 minutes. it is also not drying for my dry face.
I use this once a week and its one of my favorite producs of Tony Moly, 100% approve.
Ive used their sheet mask previously and loved them. Decided to try this from them when i was dealing with a pimple. It works great for my skin and my husband's acne prone skin.

Fragrance free, gentle, lasts a long time and really works. Also it does specifically state to apply on a DRY face. If you go in with wet hands on a wet face, its not going to adhere at all or spread well.

I've had this mask for a while and have really liked it for my skin, but I dont know if I've had it for too long or what but I just opened my container to use it and it had mold in it. Like full on green, white, and hairy mold. I've had it for less than a year, and always made sure to close it completely. I dont know if I can buy this again ):

I've been using this mask for a year or so now, and I can't live without it! It helps clarify my skin and slightly tighten my pores. I do see a slight difference right after I take it off, my skin is fresh, smooth and less red. I've noticed that when I don't use it as scheduled (every four days), my skin gets mad at me, it loves this stuff. I also use the powder face scrub every morning before regular cleansing. For reference, I have oily combo skin, with acne and texture. These products help temper all of that, love💕

avis.titre: Really nice gentle yet powerful mask
avis.texte: I see that some people are struggling with application, I picked up a silicone mask brush to apply this easier and its been a breeze. I incorporated this mask into my night skincare routine and woke up with really bright, soft skin. Def worth a try!
Smells soooo good, didn't sting at all, in fact it actually felt pretty cold & soothing on my skin.

I have so much excess oil in my skin that causes breakouts and acne, the first time i used it i noticed a significant different between my acne before and after! It really helped my confidence towards my skin and would recommend to anyone! i have very sensitive skin, and sometimes when i put on right after cleansing it will burn for a slight second so i reccommend waiting a bit after cleansing to use!
Such a great cleaning mask for your pores. I have acne prone skin and it really helps when I use weekly.

I use this 1-2x a week and i love it. I have oily acne prone skin and this mask flatten and smooth down any texture i have. I definitely recommend using it a day after taking off heavy makeup. A con would be that its difficult to take off without a cloth.

avis.titre: I would buy this over and over again
avis.texte: This reduced redness in my face immediately. I love this mask and it holds plenty of product to reuse.

avis.titre: Possibly the worst mask i've ever purchased.
avis.texte: I used this mask twice. First time, my skin was slightly irritated but that's usually normal when using a clay mask. I used it again this morning and my face has been stripped, red and raw for over 9 hours. i've been feeling a burning sensation and i have huge patches on my face that are blotchy and irritated. If you have sensitive skin, i do not recommend this product. AT ALL.
I love this mask. It's simple and easy, very nice texture. White mask. It doesn't have a bad smell and leaves my skin feeling very clean.

I tried this mask once and it worked well. Sadly, when I opened the jar to use again it was full of mold. And I mean the entire top layer was covered in mold. This is unsafe but also gross and a waste of my money.
I absolutely love this product! I have only used it for 2 weeks and I can already see my acne getting smaller overnight. I will give it more time for my skin to get clearer!

Seen some comments about this product. Was iffy about it due to the mix reviews so I decided to give it a try. It's been 3 months. I absolutely love it. I use this mask once a week. My breakouts were disappearing along with my face not being so oily. I have normal/combo skin depending on my diet, weather. I usually get oily around my t zone area and breakouts only on my cheeks. Only downfall I had with this product was washing it off. Other than love it!

Works fantastic for hormone acne, purging acne, combination skin, dry flaky skin, deep pores, uneven texture, and brightens. I'm obsessed with the product. I did prefer application with a mask brush to save product and keep it clean. I left it on for 30 mins and washed it off with a clean rag and I loved the result! Highly recommend this clean mask!

I've used this mask twice so far and it has left my skin feeling so smooth and soft. I have also noticed some of the redness in my face being reduced, and my acne being less inflamed. I will say that it has a pretty thick texture, which can make it a little difficult to apply, but overall I really like it!

I absolutely LOVE this stuff!!!I have oily skin, acne, and rosacea. My skin feels so refreshed after using this mask. I use it about twice a week after cleansing. I totally recommend and I have put many other people on it and they love it!!!

Tried it a few times and I cannot complain. I have combination skin but it's been leaning towards oily as of late. This mask has definitely helped keep my skin smooth and minimize my pores + sebaceous follicles as well. Will use it again to see further results.
This I a good mask, it does the job of cleaning out pores very well. I would buy it again.

avis.titre: Product is too Gentle for my Skin
avis.texte: There isn't really anything wrong with this product per se. It doesn't cause redness, dryness, or any kind of skin irritation whatsoever. However, for me, this mask is just too gentle for my skin. I noticed no difference after using this product. I would recommend this product to people with very sensitive skin, or people who have never used masks before. This is a clay mask, but it dries clear and doesn't have that "clay feel" to it as it dries if you get what I mean. I feel as if it has a lot of added ingredients that dilute and weaken the clay of the mask. The brand, TONYMOLY, isn't exactly the most clinical or scientific brand out there, and they have been known to add inferior ingredients to their products for the sake of smelling or looking more appealing. To restate, I would only recommend this product to people who have never used a facial mask before and have no idea how sensitive their skin is, or to people with sensitive skin (maybe not VERY sensitive skin though, because the brand isn't the most clinical or scientific).

I love this so much, it has become a regular piece in my skincare routine. It clears your face wonderfully without being too thick and irritating to delicate skin. I am quite happy with this and will be buying it again.

avis.titre: Finally, a mask that works on my skin
avis.texte: This mask doesn't dry out my skin and it got rid of my acne in 1 week. Even though it's a small container, it lasts a long time and you don't need to use a lot. I wish Tony Moly had more clay masks.
I have sensitive prone acne skin and this mask works for me. I recommend.
This made my face extremely red and made a burning feeling soon as I washed it off, the next day my face was broken out 10 times worse.
I've bought this twice and i use it all the time. It works so well and i can tell a difference every time i use it!
I'm 49 & my skin is "changing" lol. I love this. It's working it's magic.

So I've always liked TonyMoly, but I've usually tried their more cute, aesthetically pleasing products, sheet masks under eye patches, little themed things, things like that, things you don't use enough to like actually see results, right? WELL. Lemme tell ya, this product, it sounds crazy, but I saw & felt immediate results after rinsing the mask off, my skin looked & felt softer, & brighter. I've been using it for a couple days now & it really did help clear up my acne a bit. I'm sure it may not be that fast for everyone, but truly & honestly my experience was amazing & the product works, you get a lot of it. I intend to try more rinse off masks from them in the future, probably all of them, lol 🖤✨
I would highly recommend this product to people who have clogged pores and acne! It worked really well for my skin. It cleared a lot of pores and didn't bother my acne.
Less then an hour after using this product my face was burning and felt dry I definitely don't recommend using this if you have ￼sensitive skin

This mask is by far the best thing I could ever use for my acne. I have extremely dry, acne prone skin and I've tried everything on the market. It dries out the spot without drying out the rest of your skin. It can be used as a mask or a spot treatment overnight. This has taken my breakout healing time from 6-7 days to 2-4 days. For this price, you can't beat it.
Takes away all texture and skin is left soft. Isn't drying which is rare for a clay mask. I was skeptical about its claims because of the price point but it actually delivers.

I have sensitive skin but this product didn't bother my skin at all! No strong scent there's a lot in the container. Idk how well it helps with acne XD but it makes my skin feel really soft everytime I use it

I was excited to try this because I love tonymoly's rice exfoliator and the reviews said this helped with breakouts, but unfortunately it just made my breakout worse :( so beware if u have sensitive skin
Everytime I break out I use this and it makes my skin so soft and gets rid of the redness. The breakout is gone within a few days as opposed to it usually taking a few weeks. Love it!!
I used this towards the beginning of my period and my breakouts reduced significantly! I love this product and I will buy this again!

Love this stuff i've been dealing with papule and closed comedones acne reactions from my IV treatments, I've never had acne in my life before then so i've been trying a bunch of new products and this one is by far my favorite. This is my third time using it this week (i would not recommend ppl to do this as often as i have i have a lot of free time and do at home spa days for fun almost everyday lol) but so far i have seen a good change all the tiny pimples on my forehead and cheeks are gone and i'm now just dealing with these annoying big ones i read some of the reviews and someone said to use it as a spot treatment and god bless their soul for saying that! those pesky big pimples are now starting to go away im going to do as instructed and use it as a spot treatment for 2 full nights and hopefully tomorrow or the next day they'll be gone! but so far so good i would recommend this product for anyone having the same problems as me also do not buy if you have sensitive skin!!

I love this as a quick mask for if you're breaking out all over BUT its true shining moment is when you use it as a spot treatment overnight. If I use this on a pimple for two nights in a row it will be virtually GONE. Also since it uses rice as the active ingredient and not harsh chemicals, I can use it with any other products I put on my face with no issues. I've seen a couple people with sensitive skin having issues, but I have relatively sensitive skin and I've never had any. I would just recommend patch testing first since everyone's skin is different! But I highly recommend.
makes my face feel rlly soft i love this buy dont use it everyday! I have oily/combination skin

I wanted to love it but the 2nd day of using it I broke out in hives and my face was like that for around 1 week and a half :( never thought I was allergic because I've never had a reaction to anything on my face so it was a shocker. Not sure what exactly I was allergic to in the ingredients but just beware if you have sensitive skin!

I love this mask! It makes my skin feel so soft after using, and my skin is visibly clearer the next day. I like to use it in the shower after cleansing my skin. Directions suggest letting skin dry before applying- Personally I have found that it works just as well for me if applied to damp skin and never allowed to dry fully. I just leave it on for 10-15 minutes and rinse when done. Would recommend to anyone looking for softer and/or clearer skin.

I've been using this product for almost a month and omg I've seen a huge difference in my skin in so little time highly recommend it , my skin is normal to dry and it works perfectly fine with my skin type.

I have combination skin that is very oily but dries out easily and this mask is good for when I start to breakout and need to refresh my skin. I wash my face before applying the mask and I let it sit until it's completely dry before washing it off. I always moisturize afterwards since it strips all of the oil away. My skin stays clear for the next few days after use but I recommend repeating weekly if needed.

avis.titre: dries out as the contents lower
avis.texte: save your money. the product dries out and loses all moisture once you're a little more than half way through the container. waste of money and product. had to throw mine out as it was hard as a rock. the product was only purchased a couple of months ago. not old or expired. stored appropriately.
just put it on feels pretty good doesnt burn or itch feels cool and calming

I cracked open this bad boy about a half hour ago; and after applying, waiting, and rinsing: my skin is so soft. I do have a fair breakout happening right now and some of the angry redness is already gone. After using it a few more times I'll update if it truly clears the breakout, but "so far so good"

avis.titre: One of the best, affordable masks
avis.texte: I have tried so many different face masks and this one is one of my favorites. It's great for breakouts and pores - I can always tell a difference the morning after using as any inflamed acne has subsided and my skin feels great.

I've been using for a week now and I love it! I always have pimples and oily skin but this really helps. It's only been a week and I can tell it leaves my skin more even, it sooo smooth, and it doesn't dry out ur skin after use. HIGHLY RECOMMEND

So, I bought this because I was overwhelmed by the giant selection of skincare products (in actuality I grabbed the wrong jar, I meant to grab the lavender version of this cream). I took it home and put it on. After rinsing, I noticed all of my redness was gone. My skin already looked much healthier after one use. The reason I say this is basically magic though? I had a sunburn. It was completely gone on my face after using this product. I don't understand what happened, but I'm sticking with this company's products.

Cute packaging (as lots of Tonymoly stuff has). I definitely noticed some of my acne clear up after using this. It didn't tighten unnecessarily and did well to not dry out my face like other acne-focused products do. Creamy and thick texture that dried kinda patchy on my face, so layer it lightly if you want it to dry evenly (or just actually layer it evenly lol). Left my face softer than I expected it to without any exfoliation. It isn't really scented, which is nice because there's no chemical smell that wafts into your eyes/burns your nose. Definitely will buy again and makes me want to try other masks.
Feels good on skin but it ha pore clogging ingredients and caused a lot of clogging on my skin

Overall great product for sensitive skin! It does clear up blemishes to an extent, its pretty refreshing and recommend using as a spot treatment. Although, it does take a long time to deliver results,but can't expect much since its a soothing mask, other than that it has a nice consistency.

First time trying it and it feels good. After application, my skin felt soft and glowy! No burning sensation after cleansing my face which is why I don't really use face masks after but this works !! Definitely would give it a try if you can at the sale price! Knocked off one star because it doesn't come with applicator but overall good packaging.

I had seen this product and it had great reviews. I had ordered it for my son who has some what of acne on his face and on his back. At first I had contacted the original company that sells this product and asked if it would work for back acne and they stated it would. So when I received the product my son tried it out and it worked. Cleared up his back acne and face. I tried it on my face and it left it so smooth.

i used to have clear skin never breaking out until recently where i've had acne scars/blemishes for over a year now that i cant seem to get rid of. i saw this and purchased it and after one use (after my afternoon wash) i noticed by my night time wash that my skin was already clearing up ! i have oily skin and this works wonders!

This is the best textured call mask I have ever used, and it didn't bother my sensitive skin in the slightest. I was already sold on it, and then I woke up the next morning and saw a noticeable improvement in the scarring and blemishes on my cheeks.

This mask is amazing! I was a little nervous to try it since I have sensitive skin but it doesn't cause any irritation. It's gentle but has worked wonders on my skin and any breakouts are cleared the next day.
This mask is so smooth and creamy, it has no fragrance that I can see from opening up the jar. It doesn't irritate you skin and will buy again!
This works. Best money spent lately, I even use it for spot treatment on blemishes.

avis.titre: YOU NEED THIS IN YOUR LIFE -BEST MASK EVER
avis.texte: If you're contemplating on buying this, don't even think twice ADD THIS TO YOUR CART LOL this is the best mask I have used in my life no joke. Don't let the price fool you, this is a drugstore skincare product but it's the BEST i have ever used. Super hydrating, I my skin didn't feel uncomfortable while it was hardening at all and as soon as I washed it off I swear everytime my skin looks like i'm wearing foundation. My face is so even I don't even feel like I need to put any makeup on my skin anymore. I'm shocked because I didn't expect this to be THIS good. Especially because I haven't heard of this brand really. But I'm in love and will 1000% purchase this again! GO GET ONE :)

This blemish mask is heaven on my face! The texture is so smooth and glides on my face so nicely. After I washed it off I could feel the softness of my skin come back to life! I am recommending this product to my sister ASAP!

I used this product last night and already it has cleared me up! have hormonal acne along my jawline and it's so hard to find something to get rid of it. I also have dry skin and it didn't dry me out. Highly recommend!
I like how this clarifying mask did not dry out my skin. I usually steer clear of masks for that reason.

This is absolutely the mask face mask I have ever used in my entire life. This is my first clay face mask, and I am very impressed. The consistency is great, it smells nice and clean, and it really helps my acne! If you have sensitive, dry, or acne prone skin, then you should totally buy this, because it really works!

I am a huge fan of Korean cosmetic products so that TonyMoly is one of my favorite brands. I never use any of mask of them and my first impression is great. It clean out my skin of dirt and oil. Dont make my skin be dry.

This is one of the better clay like masks I've used. It didn't dry my skin out like some other mask do. Instead it left my skin feeling soft and repaired. I noticed blemishes reduce in size after use. Whe. Applied it feel nice and cool going onto the skin which I though was very nice and relaxing.
I tried this facemask and i loved it! My skin felt so soft after, i have only used it a few times but I'm excited to see the results after using it a few more times.
Helpful mask for my sensitive skin, did not irritate or cause a breakout. Light scent. Leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth.
I loved this mask. It cleared my breakouts within a few days and did not cause any irritation. I especially love the fact that it is made up of natural ingredients.

Well, it's a pretty standard, but good quality kaolin+bentonite mask, and that's not a bad thing! The sake filtrate (10,000 ppm) and Korean herbal extracts really set this product apart as they keep your skin from drying which happens with lower quality clay masks. There is no fragrance added, and the lovely subtle earthiness of pure clay takes on a hint of sake sweetness for a truly pleasant scent. I shared this with two of my friends, and it was unanimously loved.

i loved it i started using as a product review ,and well i suffer from acne and blemishes and it helped clear my skin.... it leaves my skin feeling clean and i get lots of complements on my skin now!!
I enjoyed this product more then i thought i would. I recommend
I feel like the oat was gentle but effective to help the ance on my skin right now
Easy to use, barely any fragrance (my sense of smell is terrible though), and easy to use.

I used it as directed after using my regular cleanser and I'm impressed! After using only a few times I could really see the difference in my skin. It was noticeably clearer and it reduced the little blemishes I get every now and then. I will definitely be continuing to use this mask.

I really enjoyed this mask! It has no smell whatsoever, so if you're sensitive to fragrances, that's a plus. It is clay like but not overly thick. I don't have overly sensitive skin but some masks I've tried sting or irritate— this one did not bother me one bit! I felt like a lot of the the impurities/oiliness in my skin were washed away (I left it on for 15 minutes). I do break out here and there but I feel like using this once a week has greatly helped! I am happy with this and will continue to use it!
This is a fun mask! It is easy to put in and take off! It is great to absorb facial oil. It didn't cause me to break out afterwards.
Very easy to apply and smooth coverage. Noticed my face felt better after the first use. After the third my skin was softer and brighter

I left it on for 15 minutes and after rinsing it off my (usually dry/breaking out) face... feels so refreshed!! I will definitely be purchasing this again. Glad I got to try it for free thanks to BzzAgent!

When it comes to self care, I like to start with a face mask. This blemish mask was easy to apply and a way to pamper yourself. Korean skincare really does wonders and this mask just feels good without feeling dry after washing it off.
Good product, smell is light not too strong. Helped alot with my oily skin and acne scars.
I used a plastic mask applicator for this mask and it worked great. It can be hard to apply evenly to face at times, but I just take care to make sure the areas that I want covered are.

avis.titre: TONYMOLY I'm Rice Clarifying Blemish Mask
avis.texte: I really liked this face mask. I felt like it helped with my breakouts and calmed my skin. My face looked nice and glowy after I used it and it is easy to apply. I think this is better than other masks on the market today. I would recommend this product.

I was a bit nervous to use this clay mask, as they can often dry out my skin. I was surprised to find that this mask didn't do that at all! It left my skin feeling super soft. I don't get a lot of breakouts, so I can't vouch for its ability to prevent/clear up breakouts, but it did leave my skin feeling well cleansed and soft. I wish it smelled better; it's a very mild scent which isn't offensive, but also not pleasant.
I was skeptical about this at first. But after using it my face felt amazing. Didn't really care for the smell but the effects were great!

I absolutely loved this mask! I even got my daughter and husband to join me and try the mask as well! I really felt like the mask pulled a lot of toxins out of my poors. It left my skin feeling soft and looking bright. It also seemed to help with some of the redness from my acne!

Some thickness like that of other clay masks (this one is clay and rice) but a bit creamier and easier to spread than others I've tried- I guess thanks to the rice? I've only tried it once, but have to review now because I received it complimentary from bzzz and they'll kick me out if I wait any longer. So far I love it. I rinsed it off and my face felt nice and smooth. Too early to see any potential longer term results. As you can see in my photo it dries almost totally clear..
This product went on really smooth and it felt really nice while wearing it. My skin looks and feels great!
I don't think I've ever disliked a product from TonyMoly and this mask is no exception. It made my skin feel super clean without drying it out. Very highly recommend it!
I always struggle to find a face mask that works to my liking especially in the winter. This mask made my skin super soft with lasting results.
The Tony Moly Rice Clarifying Mask went on easily. After using it, the mask made my face feel clean, and hoping this will help with me wearing my mask for up to 13 hr work days
I love this mask so much. Definitely a game changer for breakouts. i use this once or twice a week.

avis.titre: Great mask! You can feel your impurities sucked away!
avis.texte: Honestly great little mask, doesn't feel to drying or heavy like other similar masks. I really liked how smooth my skin felt afterwards.

I loved the feel of the mask, it felt very moisturizing when I put it on and the scent was nice...not too strong at all. I used this mask every other day for a few weeks and I definitely saw results. The blackheads on my nose seemed to shrink and almost go away. I also have been getting some cystic acne on my forehead and it helped that to go away. I would highly recommend this mask to anyone- even those with sensitive skin!
I love how let my skin, really I love it. I use it like 2 times per week and my husband love this too.
I love this mask the ingredients rice eliminate all the oíl of my Face and i have my Face more clear. I be continued use this mask i like the ressults.

After using this mask I did not notice a change in my skin. The breakouts along my jaw line didn't seem smaller or less red after several uses. Maybe with continued use there would be benefits but I would also think something like this would seriously dry your skin out over time. Masks are a fun treat and make for a special event but that's about where the results from this mask end for me. The packaging is cute and fun and the mask itself is nice and thick and feels food on the skin just really doesn't do much. Overall it's a fine product but doesn't deliver on the results it says it will in my opinion.
I usually find clay masks too drying, but this one was quite perfect. I only used it a couple times but my pores look more refined and my skin looks really nice. I have combination skin.
I am not into doing face masks, I don't have patience to sit for 10-15 Minutes especially when having a toddler running around you.

My skin loves this mask! It's gentle and does a great job at cleaning out gunk out my pores. I've been using it for 3 weeks and have noticed the amount of breakouts have reduced. I also noticed that my pores look slightly smaller and my face feels soo smooth and plump. This is my new holy grail!

I love the feeling of this mask going on. It's so soothing and smooth. And I like it because it doesn't feel too drying on my skin during or after. My skin really does look and feel better after using this. I was a bit hesitant at first but am pleasantly surprised.
I would definitely recommend this product because it helped my face become blemish free. My face felt less oily and so smooth after.
I absolutely love this mask. It's amazing and doesn't have a strong smell .

I enjoyed testing out this clarifying blemish mask that I received as a few sample. It has a nice smooth texture when you apply it to your face. It has a mild scent which is nice. It washes off easily but did leavr my face feeling a little dried out. That might be the point, being a clarifying mask, but I did use moisturizer afterwards . Overall I will continue to use this mask!

I used the TONYMOLY I'm Rice Clarifying Blemish Mask on my T-Zone and it helped diminish a few blemishes after a couple of uses. The mask also helped my T-Zone not get as oily as before. I used other mask but I like this one better than others because my skin didn't get dried out like it would with others. I would definitely buy this item and recommend it to friends and family. I received this complimentary product for my honest review.
Made my face so soft and cleared up any blemishes. Lightened up my dark spots too
I used this face mask and I immediately noticed a different in my skin on my face. It left it clear and hydrated. I would definitely recommend it!

Thank you Bzzagent for letting me try this product. It was given to me for free in exchange for an honest review. I have only used this mask twice so far so I'll review based on that. The mask has a nice clay-like feel and applies easily with fingers. I tried using a silicone spatula the first time and it didn't distribute well on the skin. After washing off the skin feels clean and tight. I cannot say yet as to how much it helps with blemishes and black heads. I will update my review when I've had a chance to try it for longer.

I liked this mask the moment I touched it. It feels like a natural mud or clay mask that you'd receive at a spa. The feel is very smooth and rich, but it goes on thin and light. It doesn't run, so no worries about getting it in eyes or on clothes. Once dry, it washes off with ease and leaves skin soft.

I'm Rice Clarifying Blemish mask is really nice. Easy to use, just apply over face wait to dry then rinse off. It doesn't dry out skin. I enjoyed using the mask TonyMoly doesn't disappoint. I received the mask for free to try and review. The opinions of the product are 100% my own
